title: OPM USA Staffing unauthorized access, Nov 12-13, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by OPM, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: The report says 403 tentative job offers across multiple federal agencies. USA Staffing is used by many agencies, but no source says more than those offers were reached.
who_is_affected: People with tentative federal job offers made through USA Staffing in the affected period, per the report. Those affected were reportedly notified. If you are unsure, ask your hiring agency.

known.text: USA Staffing is OPM's hiring system for federal agencies.
OPM has published no statement about this as of Nov 21.

not_known.text: Whether the access happened as described. It rests on one outlet's account of an internal email.
How the outside party got in and who they were.
Exactly what data was exposed and to whom.
Whether it has any link to the FAA ground stop or the Microsoft outage. No source gives one.
Whether OPM will make a public statement.

figures.label: Reported access dates
figures.detail: Blocked by Nov 14, per the email
